caption: The drawing depicts a ceramic figurine of a seated dog positioned on a rectangular base. The dog is primarily light gray with small raised dotted textures across its body, and it features dark, nearly black ears. The figurine also displays scattered floral decorations in red and green on its body and head, including a garland-like pattern around the head. The dog’s face is detailed with yellow eyes, outlined in black, and a painted mouth. The ceramic base is shaded in light gray tones to indicate depth and dimension. The background is plain and off-white, and the artist’s signature, "Nina Lowry," appears faintly in the lower left corner.
title: Pa. German Prince Charles Spaniel
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
